mostWorthwhile.text: Adding oxygen clarified that it receives electrons and becomes part of water, rather than serving as the fuel. That distinction is valuable for understanding respiration.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the glucose transporter was straightforward but offered little to decide: it was the only combination available.

surprise.text: Glucose import immediately led to cytosolic breakdown into pyruvate and some ATP, making clear that ATP production begins outside mitochondria.

arbitrary.text: No action seemed purposeless, but every combination was the only offered choice. The energy-transfer arrows connecting fuel processing to ATP production also left the mechanism unexplained.

continue.text: I would cautiously continue: linking respiration to ion pumping was worthwhile, though I would hope for more meaningful choices and explanation of the mechanisms.
